subject.title: feat(openshell): add non-secret env config for sandbox creation

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins.entries.openshell.config.env` as a durable OpenShell plugin config surface for non-secret sandbox-create environment variables?
rationale: The code path is technically plausible and upstream-backed, but repository policy treats new config/env surfaces as high-bar product API that automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor after docs fix
options.body: Accept `env` as plugin config, require the broken docs anchor to be fixed, and merge only after compatibility/proof stays green.

options.title: Close until sponsored
options.body: Close this PR for now and ask for a maintainer-sponsored follow-up if the config surface becomes desired.

options.title: Keep issue as tracker
options.body: Leave the linked issue open as the product-decision tracker without adopting this branch yet.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after docs fix
recommendation.body: Accept `env` as plugin config, require the broken docs anchor to be fixed, and merge only after compatibility/proof stays green.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the OpenShell backend and remote/config surfaces that the PR extends.
